title: Chips for choices
text: Selected values appear as chips with their own remove buttons.

title: Filter and toggle
text: Typing filters the list, and the list stays open for further choices.

title: Limits and select all
text: Cap the number of selections and offer a select all option.

title: Async options
text: Loads options from a server as the user types, with debouncing and cancellation.

title: Form ready
text: Submits every selected value natively, with required validation.
